about: The mutant ledger of runtime/v1: edits of the runtime's source (runtime/v1 and the runtime/rt clock it parks on) that some runtime/v1 test must kill. Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants ./runtime/v1; the runner judges it by runtime/v1's own tests (docs/tooling.md, "Mutant ledger"). Seeded in batch 14 from the mutants batch 13 killed by hand (fua-b round 2 and its verifier, /home/exedev/.cache/baton/wf10/batch-13/verify/verdicts-2.md).

mutants.name: sconv-int32-lower
mutants.rule: types.md Conversions 4: a float below int32's range saturates to its minimum.
mutants.gap: Equivalent on linux/amd64 and arm64: Go's int32 conversion of a float below the range gives math.MinInt32 on both (CVTTSD2SL's indefinite value; FCVTZS saturates), which is the rule's answer. The guard keeps the rule on a host where it is not (measured: survived TestFloatToIntegerMatchesModel on amd64, S-conv round 1).
